import http from 'node:http';import colors from 'picocolors';import {invoiceTotal} from '../invoice.mjs';const rows=[{price:12,quantity:5},{price:6.5,quantity:2}];http.createServer((req,res)=>{res.setHeader('Content-Type','application/json');res.end(JSON.stringify({total:invoiceTotal(rows),label:colors.green('invoice ready'),revision:'__REVISION__'}))}).listen(Number(process.env.PORT), '0.0.0.0');
